correctness.rationale: The RESULT.md reduction is sound: mapping centered vertex vectors to leaf differences gives diag(v_i-1)+11^T/(m+1) PSD for lambda_2≥1. At most one edge may be deficient; Schur complement gives d≤1/(m+1+sum 1/a_j) and Cauchy–Schwarz minimizes cost at C_*=sum c_i-Delta²/(m+1). The equality conditions uniquely force the displayed weights, including the boundary Delta=0 and m=2. Homogeneity gives B/C_*. For unit comparison rows (e0-ei)/sqrt(2), the one-step expected error decrease is L(p)/2 and normalized price yields 1/(2C_*). Independently checked price vectors (25,1,1), (16,9,4), (4,1) against cost and formula. Inspected complete verifier code, which checks rational principal minors; its reported log is not used as proof.
